name: Dark Botanical
tagline: Elegant italic serif headlines on near-black, soft blurred circles of terracotta, rose and gold in the corners, and hairline gold rules. Adapted from the Dark Botanical preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: near-black ground with warm off-white type, soft blurred circles of terracotta, rose and gold glowing from one or two corners, gold for numerals and hairline accents, rose for one italic phrase

typography.style: high-contrast Cormorant at light weights with italic signature phrases and italic roman numerals, paired with IBM Plex Sans Light for body and widely tracked uppercase labels

best_for: Luxury, fragrance, fashion, wine, hospitality and arts decks: product launches, collectors' and patrons' evenings, gallery talks and annual letters where atmosphere matters as much as numbers. Strong for statements, quotes and a few elegant figures.
avoid_for: Data-heavy reviews, technical training and anything that must be read at the back of a bright room. Light serif type and low-contrast secondary text need a dark room and few words.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
